description: We are seeking a Relocation Consultant to support relocating assignees and clients in Johannesburg, South Africa. You will coordinate practical relocation services, build trusted local relationships and deliver a responsive experience from first briefing to settling in. The role suits someone with strong local knowledge, excellent communication skills and a calm, service-led approach.
